name: Browan Water sensor
description: Browan TBWL100 water-leak sensor (codec payload_codec_browan_tbwl100.js, fPort 106): `status` 1 = leak / 0 = dry, re-sent while wet, plus a 60 min keep-alive with temperature and humidity. No downlink settings (config is on fPort 204, not pushed from here). Battery is a 3.6 V Li-SOCl2 cell (datasheet 3.6 V max / 3.1 V min, 0.1 V steps): warn/empty limits are an assumption, tune per device.
